Fast Track
10:00 AM 25310 Elena Road – File #SD26-0021 – Lands of Carroll Project LLC
Site Development Permit for the demolition of an existing 3,584 square-foot single-story single-family
residence, and construction of a new 5,854 square-foot two-story single-family residence, with 600 square-foot
detached garage, 883 square-foot detached ADU, and associated hardscape improvements; project includes
removal of two (2) non-heritage-oak trees.
CEQA review: Categorical Exemption per Section 15303(a).

Site Development
10:30 AM 27446 Black Mountain Road – File #SD26-0036 – Lands of Nemeth
Request for a Site Development Permit for a landscape screening plan, landscape lighting, and fencing associated
with a previously approved sports court (File #SD26-0036)
CEQA review: Categorical Exemption per Section 15304(b)

A digital copy of the meeting agenda is available on the Community Development Department webpage:
https://www.losaltoshills.ca.gov/506/Agendas-Minutes-and-Packets. If you wish to review the project plans, a copy is available
in Town Hall. If you have any questions or need additional information about this application, please contact Planning
Department at (650) 941-7222 or planning@losaltoshills.ca.gov.

Applicants scheduled on this date are requested to be present (either virtually or in person) at the listed time or be represented by
an authorized agent. If applicant is not represented at the time listed above, the meeting will be rescheduled to a later date. Court
challenges to the action of the Site Development Committee, Planning Commission, or City Council may be limited to issues
raised at the public hearing, described in this notice, or in written correspondence received at Town Hall at, or prior to, the time
of the public hearing.
To attend the meeting in person:
Duxbury Conference Room, 26379 Fremont Road, Los Altos Hills, CA 94022
To provide Public Comment in person:
Members of the public wishing to speak are requested to complete a speaker card and submit it to the Community Development
Director at the meeting.
To participate in the meeting via Zoom Video Conference, please follow the instructions below:
1. If you wish to submit a public comment on agenda items in advance of the meeting, email the Planner for the project. If
you choose to email your comments, indicate in the subject line “FOR PUBLIC COMMENT” and specify the File #.
Written comments will be posted on the City website at www.losaltoshills.ca.gov subject to Staff’s ability to post the
documents before the meeting.
2. If you wish to provide public comment during the meeting, follow this protocol: raise your hand in the Zoom application,
before sharing your comment, identify yourself by name and where you reside.
3. To join from a PC, Mac, iPad, iPhone, or Android device, click this URL to join:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/86477196354?pwd=NWwyNm9kSDNzVUw0TU4yQTNONk1qUT09
Teleconference Number: (669) 900-6833
Meeting ID: 864 7719 6354
Passcode: 398752
Or go to https://app.zoom.us/wc/join and enter the Meeting ID and Passcode above.

4. Public testimony will be taken at the direction of the Community Development Director and members of the public
may only comment during times allotted for public comments. This meeting will be broadcast via live-stream service at
http://www.losaltoshills.ca.gov.

NOTICE DATE: October 02, 2026
Town Of Los Altos Hills October 13, 2026
Fast Track Hearing Fact Sheet

Project Description: Site Development Permit for the demolition of an existing 3,584 square-foot single-story
single-family residence and two-story garage, and construction of a new 5,854 square-foot two-story single-family
residence, with 600 square-foot detached garage, 883 square-foot detached ADU, and associated hardscape
improvements; project includes removal of two (2) non-heritage-oak trees.

File Number: SD26-0021
Site Address: 25310 Elena Road
Owner(s): Carroll Project LLC
Staff Planner: Bageshri Thakar, Assistant Planner

Site Data
Net Lot Area: 1.115 acre
Average Slope: 10.7%
Lot Unit Factor: 1.098

Floor and Development Area (square footage):
Area Type Maximum Existing Proposed Increase Remaining
Development 16,182 8,714 15,058 6,344 1,124
Floor 6,550 3,584 6,537 2,953 13

Height: Maximum Proposed
On Vertical Plane 27 ft. 26’-1” ft.
Lowest to Highest 35 ft. 26’-1” ft.

Setbacks: Minimum Proposed (SFR)
Front 40 ft. 67’-4” ft.
Side (East) 30 ft. 102-4” ft.
Side (West) 30 ft. 34’-3” ft.
Rear 30 ft. 34’-6” ft

Exterior Materials: Stucco, precast limestone, seam metal roof

Parking: Required spaces: 4 - all out of setbacks.
Proposed: 4 (2 garage spaces), 2 out of setbacks.

Fast Track Points: 7 (Less than 15 points required to be eligible for Fast Track)

Grading: Cut: 880-CY Fill: 475-CY Export: 405-CY

Sewer/Septic: Public Sewer

Environmental Design & Protection Committee: EDPC reviewed the project and provided comments on
screening, tree removal, tree protection fencing, building height, well pump status, and exterior building
lighting.

Open Space Committee: No comments have been received from Open Space Committee.

Pathways Committee: No comments have been received from Pathways Committee.
